configurational_energy_deciles.energy_reference: per frame f of material m: dE_f = [E_DFT(f) - min E_DFT over R(m, N_f)] / N_f in eV/atom, R(m, N) = all published-train primary-population MPLiTrj frames of material m with N atoms (hop-independent)
configurational_energy_deciles.fit_population: decile cut points from all published-train primary-population frames, pooled (global); separate cut points for the TM/Hubbard-U secondary population
configurational_energy_deciles.binning_rule: numpy.quantile at 0.1..0.9 (method 'linear'); right-closed bins, a value equal to a cut point goes to the lower decile; coincident cut points leave a decile empty and it is reported as empty, never re-filled
configurational_energy_deciles.evidence: Research Design 5.6 ('configurational-energy decile'); DFT energies only, no ML prediction or barrier outcome. frozen pre-analysis decision 2026-10-19 before any outcome inspection; reviewed by research-architect and statistical-validator

label_budget_stability.stability_metric: SD over repeats of s_K per target hop, reported raw and finite-population-corrected (divided by sqrt((N-K)/(N-1))); the corrected SD is aggregated as the median over materials of the material-mean SD and used for the 0.03 plateau test; |median s_K - s_all| also reported; H4 is an empirical Monte Carlo result, not a formal guarantee
label_budget_stability.selection_rule: fixed common hop set (material-scope eligible frames N >= 60) for every K in {1,3,5,10,30}; K frames uniformly without replacement; seed analysis_seed(base_seed, 'study1_label_budget', scope, target, hop_id, K, repeat) without model_id (common random numbers across models); plateau K* = smallest K with median SD <= 0.03 (augmentation of RD 4 H4 '+/-0.03'); H4 supported iff K* <= 10; label-budget subsamples are exempt from the full-estimate minimum-support rule
label_budget_stability.evidence: Research Design 3.6 (K values, repeated subsampling), 4 RQ4/H4; R=1000 gives ~2.2% relative MC error in SD(s_K). frozen pre-analysis decision 2026-10-19 before any outcome inspection; reviewed by research-architect and statistical-validator
label_budget_stability.population_rule: per hop, fixed once before any draw and identical for every K, s_all and model: leakage-eligible material-scope frames with at least one |F_DFT| >= 0.1 eV/A component; >= 60 such frames; subsamples are never filtered or redrawn on their own forces; a zero Eq. 17 denominator is an error, recorded and reported
label_budget_stability.hop_set_rule: the qualifying hop set is frozen as a manifest (hop_id list + SHA-256) before analysis and is identical for every model and K

holm_family.family: Holm over {P1_m for each Group-A model m with s-bar <= 0.9} plus P2; P1_m p-value = one-sided chemical-system cluster-bootstrap p for rho_SRT <= 0; RQ1 'CI > 0' is read as the Holm-adjusted test; P3 is a validity check outside the family; Holm-adjusted P1 is final only once P2 (Study 3) exists
holm_family.evidence: Research Design 5.11 (Holm across P1-P2; P3 validity), 4 Table 4 RQ1; the per-model family is an augmentation. frozen pre-analysis decision 2026-10-19 before any outcome inspection; reviewed by research-architect and statistical-validator
